travelerPickup.additionalInfo:
The search is carried out only by accommodations within the microcenter of Mendoza City.
The pick-up service has a grid that assembles the tour guide knowing all the accommodations you must pass through. So they should be ready at the start time of the tour, knowing that you can have a delay of about 30 to 40 minutes depending on the tour of the service.

body.description: Explore the magic of Maipu on this half-day tour, visiting three wineries and an olivicola, where all tastings are included. Enjoy the quality of handcrafted wines and oils, in places that reflect passion and care in every detail. An authentic experience for true wine lovers. Don't miss it!

inclusions.otherDescription: Tasting of products in the olive oil factory Included

inclusions.description: Tastings included in wineries for adults

exclusions.otherDescription: Water and/or snacks during the excursion

additionalInfo.description: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

cancellationPolicy.description: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.

itineraryItems.description: Winery of organic wines. We will visit the vineyard, process of making and tasting three wines. Availability of the wineries in this selection may vary: Vistandes, Viña el Cerno or Domiciano.

Visit in the vineyard, elaboration process, wine storage cava and finish with the tasting of three wines. Availability of the wineries in this selection may vary: Family Cecchin, Viña el Cerno or Domiciano.

In this visit you can tour the olive groves, its olive mill and perform a tasting of olives, oils and preserves derived from the olive tree. In case of unavailability in the olive grove is replaced by the Centennial olive grove of the same characteristics.
Visit to the museum and winery. Tasting of sweet wines. Availability of the wineries in this selection may vary: Essence 1870.
